name: LethalPirateClark
description: Adds Pirate Clark, a Backrooms 'Still Life': an uncanny copied corpse in a pirate's coat who advances on you, flickers lights, breaks down doors, and turns the players he kills into new Still Lifes. v3.0.0 ships without an asset bundle — the entire prefab is built in pure C# at runtime, which makes the mod 100% reliable across Unity versions and immune to the bundle-load failures that plagued v1.x–v2.x. Model CC-BY Slightlyoversizedsweater.
